# MSFT close for the 2026-09-19 question: research as of 2026-09-09

None of my page fetches worked: Yahoo, StockAnalysis, StatMuse, AlphaQuery and ad-hoc-news all returned "proxy refused the connection". Every figure below comes from search-result summaries. Some prices come from a single site (mostly StatMuse) and I could not check them against a second source. I left out everything dated after 2026-09-09.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not load Yahoo's MSFT history page.
- 2026-09-08: the latest close I found was **$493.95**, down 1.15% on the day. The day's range was $490.15 to $495.19 on about 18.9M shares. The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.3% that day. [ad-hoc-news](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/microsoft-stock-heads-into-the-open-after-a-1-15-percent-drop/70079407)
- I found no price for 2026-09-09.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. About 7 trading days remain (Sept 9 to Sept 18). The stock sits in the lower-middle of the 400 to 600 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08: down 1.15% to $493.95, a weaker day than the Nasdaq. [ad-hoc-news](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/microsoft-stock-heads-into-the-open-after-a-1-15-percent-drop/70079407)
- 2026-09-04: closed $499.70. It opened at $510.00 and sold off during the day. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-since-15-aug-to-today)
- 2026-09-03: closed $510.12. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-since-15-aug-to-today)
- 2026-09-02: closed $496.82. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-since-15-aug-to-today)
- 2026-09-01: closed $501.02, from a search summary of StatMuse and similar tables. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-since-15-aug-to-today)
- 2026-08-31: closed $507.29, up 6.7% for August. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-august-chart)
- 2026-07-29/30: fiscal Q4 results beat estimates. Azure growth sped up to about 43% and Azure passed $100B in revenue for the fiscal year. The shares jumped about 9%, to around $427. Before the report the stock had been down about 19% year to date. [247wallst](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/07/30/microsoft-surges-9-as-azure-tops-100b-and-q4-beat-lifts-most-price-targets/), [TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/microsoft-nasdaq-msft-stock-pops-8-after-the-tech-giant-crushed-fiscal-q4-estimates)
- Earlier in 2026: the stock fell about 10% after the January report on worries about AI capex (about $190B planned). One report says the post-July guidance cut calendar 2026 capex to $175B. [Gigazine](https://www.gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260130-microsoft-earnings-market-cap)
- Background: reports say OpenAI may push its IPO back to 2027. Microsoft owns roughly 27% of OpenAI. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3054328/openai-could-delay-its-ipo-until-2027-what-that-means-for-microsoft-stock)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-31: closes ranged from about $479 (Aug 17) to $513.53 (Aug 28), roughly a 7% range within one month. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/microsoft-stock-price-august-chart)
- 2026-09-01 to 09-08: closes ranged from $493.95 to $510.12. Day-to-day moves of 1 to 2% were common.
- As of 2026-08-05, the 52-week range was reported as $349.20 to $553.72. [Bullfincher](https://bullfincher.io/companies/microsoft-corporation/stock-price-history)
- Trend: the stock rallied from about $427 at the end of July to about $510, then pulled back slightly in early September.
- My own rough estimate, not a sourced figure: if annualized volatility is 25 to 30%, one standard deviation over 7 trading days is about 4 to 5%, or roughly $20 to $25 from $494. A 1-sigma band would be about $470 to $518. I could not get AlphaQuery's implied or historical volatility figures because the fetch failed. [AlphaQuery](https://www.alphaquery.com/stock/MSFT/volatility-option-statistics)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs daily MSFT "up or down" and "close above $X" contracts. For example, Sept 2 had about $3K in volume. I found no live odds for a Sept 18 close as of Sept 9. [struct.to](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/msft-up-or-down-on-september-2-2026), [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/msft-close-above-on-september-21-2026)
- I found nothing on Kalshi or Manifold for this date.
- Analyst consensus 12-month targets are around $585 to $605, rated Buy or Moderate Buy. Those numbers come from aggregator pages I saw only in their current versions, so I can't confirm the values as of Sept 9. They are 12-month targets and say little about a 7-day horizon. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/nasdaq/msft/price-target), [WallStreetZen](https://www.wallstreetzen.com/stocks/us/nasdaq/msft/stock-forecast)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Around 2026-09-10/11: the August CPI release. I could not find the exact date. Energy has been pushing CPI up, and oil is high. [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table)
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting. The decision is due Sept 16 at 2:00 pm ET, followed by Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference and a new dot plot. The fed funds rate is 3.50 to 3.75%. Previews disagree: some call a 25bp hike the market's base case, while most brokerages expect a hold. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/september-2026-fomc-decision-will-the-fed-hike-rates-or-hold), [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table)
- 2026-09-18: quarterly options expiration (quad witching) falls on the resolution day, which could make the close more volatile.
- No Microsoft earnings are due before resolution; fiscal Q1 FY27 results would come in late October. Possible stock movers include OpenAI news, AI capex headlines, and moves in Treasury yields and oil.
